top_offers.title: CTO / Lead Engineer / Co-Founder
top_offers.why: A Tenity-backed energy fintech building a peer-to-peer green energy trading platform, looking for a CTO/co-founder to own the technology from the ground up, which is exactly the Alaya blank-page scenario in Magino's background. Zurich-based with founder-level equity, and the mission (accelerating the energy transition) fits his preference for impact-driven companies over pure enterprise work.

top_offers.title: Founding Backend Engineer
top_offers.why: Gradle owns the build tooling running CI at companies like LinkedIn and Netflix, and this founding-level backend seat with 2-3% equity is platform engineering in its purest form. Lucerne keeps him in Switzerland, and the developer-tooling domain overlaps with his platform and architecture background even though the core stack is JVM rather than TypeScript.

top_offers.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
top_offers.why: Apheris runs federated computing infrastructure so pharma companies can train AI models without sharing proprietary data, a strong technical match on Kubernetes and cloud platform work plus genuine AI exposure. Remote-first with occasional Berlin office days, so it's workable from Geneva, though the role reads more IC-platform than the Staff+/founding scope Magino is targeting.

top_offers.title: Chief Technology Officer
top_offers.why: An early-stage Swiss startup building a mobile and web platform for curated in-person events, hiring a CTO to define the whole technology roadmap. Founder-level scope and Swiss location are a fit, but the mobile-first stack and social/consumer product angle are further from Magino's platform and AI-augmented engineering focus than his top targets.

top_offers.title: CTO, Robotics
top_offers.why: ANYbotics is a Zurich robotics scale-up looking for a CTO to lead a 40-person interdisciplinary engineering team, which lines up with Magino's cofounder and technical-leadership experience scaling Alaya. The stack leans hardware and embedded robotics rather than his usual TypeScript/Node/Python platform work, so it's more of a leadership-transfer bet than a direct technical match.

top_offers.title: Chief Technology Officer
top_offers.why: A small, Google-alumni-founded startup applying neuroscience and AI gamification to habit change, hiring a CTO to lead a Flutter app team of three to four engineers. Founder-level title and fully remote, but it's an early, small-team mobile product further from his platform-scale background, included mainly to round out today's shortlist.
